g.text: Design class diagram (1 of 2) — network, tracking and real-time components
Type names written as {…} are inline TypeScript object types; there is no named class for them.
+stopsReached(from: number | null, to: number, radius: number): string[]
+updateRoute(actorId: string, id: string, patch: RoutePatch): Route
+recordFixes(driverId: string, tripId: string, fixes, sentAt?): RecordFixesResult
+terminateTrip(actorId: string, tripId: string, reason: unknown): Trip
+attach(req, res, role: Role, sessionExpiresAt: number): void
